findings.label: Payment provider stubbed
findings.description: SafePay and Stripe payment integration is not implemented; webhook handling and subscription renewal are deferred to Phase G. Subscriptions can be created but are assumed to remain ACTIVE; no automatic expiration or renewal job runs until Phase G.

findings.label: Room state transitions not documented in code
findings.description: The state machine (DRAFT → REGISTRATION → READY → LIVE → COMPLETED) is implicit in guards but should be explicitly documented as an audit trail or state diagram for future phases.

findings.label: Spectator role validation deferred to Phase G
findings.description: Spectator read-only enforcement at the bidding endpoint is stubbed; Phase G will add `RoleGuard('TEAM_OWNER')` checks on /bid and /settle endpoints.
